{{Quote|The Massassi captured Exar Kun, and then offered him as a sacrifice to an ancient ''Sith wyrm''. Facing death, Kun fully embraced the dark side and channeled his hatred to kill the wyrm.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|int=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War}}</ref>}}
'''Hatred''' was an often involuntary exertion of [[Force power/Legends|Bogan's power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to fully embrace the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], letting their hate radiate from their body in palpable waves.

In [[43 ABY]], when faced with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] similar in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to her [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] used this power in her fear and anger. She was convinced to dissipate her rage and gathered power by her [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|grandmother]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon novel">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
